title: BEP Software Environment Capture Fields

entries.name: Function / Workflow
entries.description: Governed project function served by the product, such as authoring, coordination/clash, model checking, issue tracking, visualization, scheduling, costing, CDE access, conversion or publishing.

entries.name: Vendor
entries.description: Product vendor or provider where relevant.

entries.name: Version Policy
entries.description: Approved version, version range, release/build constraint or governed upgrade rule.

entries.name: File / Exchange Types
entries.description: Applicable native, exchange, coordination or published formats used by the workflow.

entries.name: Discipline / Role Scope
entries.description: Disciplines, teams or roles expected to use or depend on the environment.

entries.name: License / Service Owner
entries.description: Project organization or governed role responsible for licensing, service ownership or support where material.

entries.name: Authority / Source
entries.description: Project source, appointment, BEP decision, tool-authority entry or other evidence supporting the selection.

entries.name: Exchange Compatibility
entries.description: Required compatibility with connectors, downstream products, exchange versions or CDE workflows.

entries.name: Template / Rulepack / Configuration Reference
entries.description: Controlled template, checker rulepack, configuration, plugin or extension reference where applicable.

entries.name: Access / Viewer Model
entries.description: Stakeholder access mode such as desktop, web, SSO or guest where relevant.

entries.name: Exception / Upgrade Rule
entries.description: Governed handling for version conflicts, upgrades, temporary exceptions or unsupported combinations.

entries.name: Status
entries.description: Project state such as proposed, approved, TBC, deprecated or superseded.

governance_notes: This registry defines the capture contract for BEP software-environment project data; it does not approve products or versions.
It supports the software_environment topic in the governed BEP workflow, including question BEP-Q-008; the question identifier is descriptive context rather than a cross-object registry reference.
Product authority must not be inferred from technical capability or source-era examples; applicable S9 tool-authority decisions remain separately governed.
Only fields material to the selected workflow need values; missing required project decisions remain unresolved or deferred rather than invented.

provenance.source_title: BEP Interview Production — Punch List (Readiness to Production)
provenance.migration_note: Migrates the durable software-environment capture contract. Source-era product examples and runtime/module naming are not promoted as authority.
